title: Run Lighthouse performance audit on production build
description: Capture Lighthouse Performance score, FCP, LCP, TBT, and CLS metrics using chrome-devtools MCP. These baselines are required by roadmap success criteria 1-4.
action: Start dev server, navigate to app via chrome-devtools MCP, run lighthouse_audit, capture Performance/FCP/LCP/TBT/CLS scores, write results to .workflow/scratch/20260504-analyze-P1-profiling/lighthouse-baseline.json

criteria: lighthouse-baseline.json contains 'performance_score' field with numeric value
convergence.verification: Read lighthouse-baseline.json and verify all 5 metric fields exist with numeric values
convergence.definition_of_done: Lighthouse Performance audit completed with all 5 core metrics captured and saved

files.change: Create JSON file with performance_score, fcp, lcp, tbt, cls fields from Lighthouse audit

implementation: Run 'npm run build' to create production build
Start dev server or preview server for the built app
Use chrome-devtools MCP: list_pages to find app page, or new_page + navigate_page to localhost
Run chrome-devtools lighthouse_audit on the page
Parse Lighthouse results and extract: performanceScore, first-contentful-paint, largest-contentful-paint, total-blocking-time, cumulative-layout-shift
Write structured JSON to lighthouse-baseline.json with all 5 metrics plus timestamp

success_metrics: All 5 metrics present with numeric values

rationale.chosen_approach: chrome-devtools MCP provides programmatic Lighthouse access without manual browser interaction
rationale.tradeoffs: Scores may vary slightly from manual Lighthouse run due to MCP overhead

risks: Dev server may not start in CI environment
Lighthouse may timeout on Tauri desktop app
